speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child presenting with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding gums, and a rash of small red spots on your skin. To understand what might be wrong, can you tell me if you have a history of easy bruising or if anyone in your family has had bleeding issues?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).

The clinical presentation of frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, petechiae, and easy bruising in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of immune thrombocytopenia. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with platelet count.
